skill_yaml:
skill: door_push
phases:
- id: rotate_1
  type: rotate
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
- id: retract_1
  type: retract
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    retract_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.2
- id: descend_1
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: admittance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    depth:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1

skill: door_push
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_handle
  anchor: fixture
  offset:
  - -0.4
  - -0.02
  - 0.35
  weight: 0.3
- id: push_door
  anchor: world
  target_entity: hinge
  metric: hinge_angle
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: approach_handle
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: site
    entity: door_handle
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    tolerance: 0.01
  parameters:
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: reach_handle
- id: push_door_open
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: admittance_control
  termination: time_limit
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: site
    entity: door_handle
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.3
      axis: task_goal_direction
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: positive
  parameters:
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.6
      default: 0.3
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    push_time:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 1.0
      - 5.0
      default: 3.0
      binds_to:
      - path: duration.max_time
        mode: replace
  retries:
    max_attempts: 1
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.01
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: push_door

skill: door_push
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_handle

  - 0.35
  weight: 0.3
- id: push_door
  anchor: world
  target_entity: hinge
  metric: hinge_angle
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: approach_handle
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: site
    entity: door_handle
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    tolerance: 0.02
  parameters:
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: reach_handle
- id: push_door_open
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: admittance_control
  termination: time_limit
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: site
    entity: door_handle
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.3
      axis: world_y
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: negative
  parameters:
    hinge_threshold:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.2
      - 0.8
      default: 0.5
      binds_to:
      - path: guards.hinge_progress.threshold
        mode: replace
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.6
      default: 0.3
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    push_time:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 2.0
      - 6.0
      default: 4.0
      binds_to:
      - path: duration.max_time
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: hinge_progress
    when: during_phase
    predicate: hinge_delta_reached
    threshold: 0.5
    on_failure: continue
  retries:
    max_attempts: 1
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - -0.01
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: push_door
